overviewHtml:
This graded quiz assesses your understanding of Heidegger's account of being-in-the-world. You'll be asked about the question of being and Dasein, readiness-to-hand and presence-at-hand, and mood, understanding, and care.

Note: Aim for a score of 80 percent or higher. If you score lower, use the feedback to review the topics you missed, then retake the quiz.

forms.stemHtml: A philosopher answers "What does it mean to be?" by saying that everything is ultimately matter. What would Heidegger object?

options.html: That matter is too small a category to include minds
options.text: That matter is too small a category to include minds
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: That it names a kind of being, not being itself
options.text: That it names a kind of being, not being itself
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Pointing to a kind of thing, such as matter, answers a question about beings. It passes over the ontological difference.

options.html: That the question can't be asked, since being is undefinable
options.text: That the question can't be asked, since being is undefinable
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: That only the sciences can answer questions about matter
options.text: That only the sciences can answer questions about matter
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

forms.stemHtml: Why does Heidegger avoid calling us "subjects" or "consciousnesses"?

options.html: Because those terms apply only to animals and not to humans
options.text: Because those terms apply only to animals and not to humans
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: Because they treat the self as a thing with inner properties
options.text: Because they treat the self as a thing with inner properties
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Such terms carry an ontology in which the self is a thing present with properties. "Dasein" is meant to avoid that assumption.

options.html: Because he believes that humans have no inner life at all
options.text: Because he believes that humans have no inner life at all
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: Because they are too technical for a general readership
options.text: Because they are too technical for a general readership
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

forms.stemHtml: What is Heidegger's term for the fact that Dasein always already finds itself in a world and a situation it didn't choose, bound up with the beings it meets there? Enter one word.

options.html: facticity
options.text: facticity
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Unlike a stone's mere factuality, Dasein's facticity is lived.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

forms.stemHtml: A surgeon's attention is on the tissue, not the scalpel, which she handles without looking at it. How is the scalpel given?

options.html: As present-at-hand, an object with measurable properties
options.text: As present-at-hand, an object with measurable properties
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

options.html: As ready-to-hand, withdrawn while she attends to the task
options.text: As ready-to-hand, withdrawn while she attends to the task
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! In use, equipment withdraws from attention, and circumspection guides the task.

options.html: As obtrusive, since it stands between her and the tissue
options.text: As obtrusive, since it stands between her and the tissue
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on breakdown and presence-at-hand.

options.html: As absent, since she isn't aware of anything at all
options.text: As absent, since she isn't aware of anything at all
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

forms.stemHtml: Which of the following are modes of breakdown in Heidegger's analysis? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Conspicuousness
options.text: Conspicuousness
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Equipment that is damaged or unusable stands out.

options.html: Obtrusiveness
options.text: Obtrusiveness
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Equipment that is missing obtrudes by its absence.

options.html: Obstinacy
options.text: Obstinacy
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Something that isn't damaged or missing stands in the way.

options.html: Circumspection
options.text: Circumspection
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

options.html: Significance
options.text: Significance
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on worldhood and significance.

forms.stemHtml: What is Heidegger's term for the practical sight that guides use, directed at the task and its context rather than at the tool? Enter one word.

options.html: circumspection
options.text: circumspection
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Circumspection (Umsicht) shows that ready-to-hand use isn't blind.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

forms.stemHtml: Which statement best captures Heidegger's claim that there is no mood-free condition?

options.html: People who train themselves can reach a state without moods
options.text: People who train themselves can reach a state without moods
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: Even indifference or evenness is a way of being attuned
options.text: Even indifference or evenness is a way of being attuned
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Dasein always already finds itself in some mood. Even the flat mood of an ordinary day is a mood.

options.html: Moods are always strong enough to be noticed by others
options.text: Moods are always strong enough to be noticed by others
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: Only moods with a definite object count as real moods
options.text: Only moods with a definite object count as real moods
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

forms.stemHtml: Heidegger builds on the German sich auf etwas verstehen, "to know how to do something." What does this show about his concept of understanding?

options.html: That understanding is a theory about one's own abilities
options.text: That understanding is a theory about one's own abilities
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

options.html: That understanding is practical know-how, a being-able-to
options.text: That understanding is practical know-how, a being-able-to
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Understanding, for Heidegger, is a practical being-able-to, projected onto possibilities.

options.html: That understanding is limited to manual and physical skills
options.text: That understanding is limited to manual and physical skills
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

options.html: That understanding comes only after careful interpretation
options.text: That understanding comes only after careful interpretation
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

forms.stemHtml: In Heidegger's care structure, which existential structure corresponds to being-ahead-of-itself?

options.html: Facticity
options.text: Facticity
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Existentiality
options.text: Existentiality
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Being-ahead-of-itself is existentiality: Dasein's being out ahead of itself in its possibilities.

options.html: Falling
options.text: Falling
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Thrownness
options.text: Thrownness
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

forms.stemHtml: Which of the following are themes of Division II of Being and Time? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Being-toward-death
options.text: Being-toward-death
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Division II treats death as Dasein's ownmost possibility.

options.html: Authenticity and inauthenticity
options.text: Authenticity and inauthenticity
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Division II contrasts owning one's existence with living through the "they."

options.html: Temporality as the meaning of care
options.text: Temporality as the meaning of care
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Division II argues that time is the meaning of care.

options.html: The analysis of equipment and the hammer
options.text: The analysis of equipment and the hammer
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Division II in overview.

options.html: Heidegger's later essays on technology
options.text: Heidegger's later essays on technology
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Division II in overview.

forms.stemHtml: Why does Heidegger begin the inquiry into being with an analysis of Dasein?

options.html: Because Dasein is the highest and most perfect being
options.text: Because Dasein is the highest and most perfect being
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: Because only minds can be studied with certainty
options.text: Because only minds can be studied with certainty
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: Because Dasein already has an understanding of being
options.text: Because Dasein already has an understanding of being
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Dasein has a pre-ontological understanding of being and can ask the question, so the inquiry starts there.

options.html: Because being is a property that only humans possess
options.text: Because being is a property that only humans possess
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

forms.stemHtml: Heidegger contrasts water in a glass with Dasein's being-in-the-world. What is the point of the contrast?

options.html: That Dasein, like water, takes the shape of its container
options.text: That Dasein, like water, takes the shape of its container
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: That the world is a larger container than a glass
options.text: That the world is a larger container than a glass
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: That Dasein's "in" means dwelling and familiarity
options.text: That Dasein's "in" means dwelling and familiarity
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Water is in a glass by spatial inclusion. Dasein is in the world as one is at home in a city or involved in a job.

options.html: That Dasein can leave the world as water leaves a glass
options.text: That Dasein can leave the world as water leaves a glass
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

forms.stemHtml: What is Heidegger's name for the analysis of Dasein that lays the groundwork for raising the question of the meaning of being in general? Enter two words.

options.html: fundamental ontology
options.text: fundamental ontology
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Fundamental ontology analyzes Dasein as the being that understands being.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

forms.stemHtml: In Heidegger's chain of references, what does the chain from hammer to nail to house finally end in?

options.html: The raw materials the hammer is made from
options.text: The raw materials the hammer is made from
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

options.html: The largest item of equipment in the workshop
options.text: The largest item of equipment in the workshop
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

options.html: A for-the-sake-of-which, a possibility of Dasein
options.text: A for-the-sake-of-which, a possibility of Dasein
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! The referential totality ends in something that isn't equipment: a possibility of Dasein's own being.

options.html: The physical laws that govern the tools' motion
options.text: The physical laws that govern the tools' motion
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on equipment and readiness-to-hand.

forms.stemHtml: Which of the following are features of Dreyfus's account of absorbed coping? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: It responds to the situation without explicit rules
options.text: It responds to the situation without explicit rules
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Absorbed coping responds to what the situation solicits, not to rules.

options.html: It rests on a background of shared practices
options.text: It rests on a background of shared practices
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Dreyfus holds that the background can't be fully spelled out as rules or beliefs.

options.html: It depends on detailed mental representations
options.text: It depends on detailed mental representations
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on absorbed coping and the McDowell–Dreyfus debate.

options.html: It is a form of explicit, step-by-step deliberation
options.text: It is a form of explicit, step-by-step deliberation
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on absorbed coping and the McDowell–Dreyfus debate.

forms.stemHtml: A violinist's bow hair snaps mid-phrase, and the bow suddenly stands out as damaged and unusable. What is Heidegger's term for this mode of breakdown? Enter one word.

options.html: conspicuousness
options.text: conspicuousness
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Damaged or unusable equipment stands out. Heidegger calls this conspicuousness.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on breakdown and presence-at-hand.

forms.stemHtml: In fear, what is "that about which" one fears, on Heidegger's analysis?

options.html: The threatening thing that draws near in the world
options.text: The threatening thing that draws near in the world
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: The inner feeling of dread that the threat produces
options.text: The inner feeling of dread that the threat produces
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: Dasein itself, its own being
options.text: Dasein itself, its own being
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! What one fears is something definite in the world; what one fears about is Dasein's own being.

options.html: Other people who might witness the danger
options.text: Other people who might witness the danger
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

forms.stemHtml: A nurse walks onto a ward, and the monitors, charts, and patients show up in the light of what she's there to do. How does Heidegger describe this?

options.html: As interpretation, adding meaning to neutral objects
options.text: As interpretation, adding meaning to neutral objects
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

options.html: As fear, since the ward may contain threats
options.text: As fear, since the ward may contain threats
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: As understanding, projecting onto a possibility
options.text: As understanding, projecting onto a possibility
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Her self-understanding as a nurse projects onto a possibility, and the ward shows up in its light.

options.html: As falling, since she's absorbed in her work
options.text: As falling, since she's absorbed in her work
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

forms.stemHtml: Heidegger says the "they" is an existential structure of Dasein, not simply something bad. Why?

options.html: Because the "they" is always right about what matters
options.text: Because the "they" is always right about what matters
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Because only other people belong to the "they"
options.text: Because only other people belong to the "they"
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Because shared norms make a common world intelligible
options.text: Because shared norms make a common world intelligible
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Without shared norms you couldn't use a fork or a language. The "they" also covers over Dasein's ownmost being.

options.html: Because the "they" disappears in authentic existence
options.text: Because the "they" disappears in authentic existence
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

forms.stemHtml: Which of the following are claims Heidegger makes about moods? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: Moods disclose thrownness
options.text: Moods disclose thrownness
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! In a mood, Dasein is brought before the fact that it is, and has to be.

options.html: Moods let things matter
options.text: Moods let things matter
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Only because Dasein is attuned can anything touch it or strike it.

options.html: Moods come from inside the mind
options.text: Moods come from inside the mind
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: Moods follow from judgments
options.text: Moods follow from judgments
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

forms.stemHtml: Heidegger says every science rests on ontological assumptions. Which example fits his claim?

options.html: Biology measures the growth rates of cell cultures
options.text: Biology measures the growth rates of cell cultures
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: Physics records the results of repeated experiments
options.text: Physics records the results of repeated experiments
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: Chemistry lists the elements in the periodic table
options.text: Chemistry lists the elements in the periodic table
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the question of being and the ontological difference.

options.html: Biology presupposes some account of what it is to be alive
options.text: Biology presupposes some account of what it is to be alive
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! What it is to be alive is an ontological question. The ontic findings of biology rest on an answer to it.

forms.stemHtml: In his 1925 lectures, what does Heidegger say Husserl neglected?

options.html: The role of the brain in producing consciousness
options.text: The role of the brain in producing consciousness
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: The use of experiments to test descriptions
options.text: The use of experiments to test descriptions
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: The importance of logic for phenomenology
options.text: The importance of logic for phenomenology
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on Dasein and being-in-the-world.

options.html: The question of the being of the intentional
options.text: The question of the being of the intentional
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Heidegger argues that Husserl never asked what kind of being intentional acts, and the one who performs them, actually have.

forms.stemHtml: What is the name for the circularity by which interpretation starts from and develops an understanding it already has, which Heidegger holds isn't vicious? Enter two words.

options.html: hermeneutic circle
options.text: hermeneutic circle
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! For Heidegger, the task isn't to escape the circle but to enter it the right way.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on hermeneutic phenomenology.

forms.stemHtml: How does Heidegger's critique of Descartes relate to presence-at-hand?

options.html: Descartes ignored presence-at-hand in favor of use
options.text: Descartes ignored presence-at-hand in favor of use
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on worldhood and the critique of Descartes.

options.html: Descartes rightly showed that use is basic to worldhood
options.text: Descartes rightly showed that use is basic to worldhood
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on worldhood and the critique of Descartes.

options.html: Descartes took presence-at-hand as the world's being
options.text: Descartes took presence-at-hand as the world's being
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! By treating the world as extended substance, Descartes took one derivative mode of being as basic, and so missed worldhood.

options.html: Descartes showed that significance is in the objects
options.text: Descartes showed that significance is in the objects
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on worldhood and the critique of Descartes.

forms.stemHtml: A carpenter's saw jams in a knot in the wood. Which of the following does Heidegger's analysis say this breakdown can reveal? (Select all that apply.)

options.html: The saw as an object with properties, such as a dull blade
options.text: The saw as an object with properties, such as a dull blade
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! In breakdown, the tool shows up as present-at-hand.

options.html: The task the saw was for, and the context of references
options.text: The task the saw was for, and the context of references
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Breakdown lights up the referential totality, not just the broken tool.

options.html: That the saw had never really been ready-to-hand
options.text: That the saw had never really been ready-to-hand
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on breakdown and presence-at-hand.

options.html: The saw's true nature, hidden from use until now
options.text: The saw's true nature, hidden from use until now
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on breakdown and presence-at-hand.

forms.stemHtml: Nothing is broken or missing, but a stack of boxes blocks the door you need to carry a table through. What is Heidegger's term for this mode of breakdown? Enter one word.

options.html: obstinacy
options.text: obstinacy
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Something that isn't damaged or missing stands in the way. Heidegger calls this obstinacy.

forms.defaultFeedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on breakdown and presence-at-hand.

forms.stemHtml: Heidegger calls the result of anxiety "uncanniness." What does it name?

options.html: A sense of being watched by a hidden other
options.text: A sense of being watched by a hidden other
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: A fear of some unfamiliar object in the world
options.text: A fear of some unfamiliar object in the world
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: A memory of an earlier, frightening experience
options.text: A memory of an earlier, frightening experience
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on attunement, thrownness, fear, and anxiety.

options.html: Not-being-at-home in the familiar world
options.text: Not-being-at-home in the familiar world
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! In anxiety, everyday significance falls away, and Dasein is no longer at home in the familiar world.

options.html: Interpretation comes first and produces understanding
options.text: Interpretation comes first and produces understanding

options.html: They're unrelated faculties of the mind
options.text: They're unrelated faculties of the mind
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

options.html: Interpretation adds meaning to what's understood
options.text: Interpretation adds meaning to what's understood
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on understanding as projection and care.

options.html: Interpretation makes explicit what's understood
options.text: Interpretation makes explicit what's understood

forms.stemHtml: What does Heidegger mean by "falling"?

options.html: A moral lapse from a higher, purer state of being
options.text: A moral lapse from a higher, purer state of being
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: A loss of physical balance or bodily control
options.text: A loss of physical balance or bodily control
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Everyday absorption in concerns and the "they"
options.text: Everyday absorption in concerns and the "they"
options.feedbackHtml: Correct! Falling is Dasein's everyday absorption, through which it understands itself in the terms of what it's busy with and what "one" does.

options.html: The final collapse of the world in anxiety
options.text: The final collapse of the world in anxiety
options.feedbackHtml: Sorry, that's incorrect. Review the reading on the care structure, falling, and the "they."

options.html: Bodily feelings of being in the world as a whole

options.text: Feelings that can change in psychiatric conditions

options.html: Emotions directed at one particular object
options.text: Emotions directed at one particular object

options.text: Moods that only a clinician can observe
